Restore your own image

Follow the installation and model setup on a computer with a supported GPU, then run:

firedesmoke demo --model firedesmoke --port 7860

Open http://127.0.0.1:7860/ on that computer. Choose an example or upload a PNG or JPEG to compare and download the restored image.

The complete FireDesmoke model uses 384-pixel overlapping windows and horizontal-flip averaging. All demo uploads and examples use this complete model. Demo uploads are resized to a maximum long side of 640 pixels. Dense smoke can hide details the model cannot recover.
